# general_crud_tool

> General CRUD and relationship management tool for all data models.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `data` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations (default); grantable to agents |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=general_crud_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

General CRUD and relationship management tool for all data models.

NOT FOR STATUS CHANGES. "mark X complete", "set status to Y", "close this"
-> apply_status_tool, ALWAYS. Passing current_status here is rejected.

ACTIONS: create, update, list, details, destroy
RELATIONSHIP_ACTIONS: link, unlink, list_linked (use relationship_action parameter)

SUPPORTED MODELS: Party, Individual, Organization, PartyRole, RoleType, PartyRelationship, PartyRelationshipType, Capability, CapabilityAssignment, SecurityRole, SecurityRoleAssignment, BizTxnEvent, BizTxnEventType, BizTxnEventReln, BizTxnEventRelnType, BizTxnPartyRole, BizTxnAccount, BizTxnAccountPartyRole, DynamicModel, DynamicModelAssociation, DynamicModelType, ExternalSystem, MdmEntity, MdmExternalMapping, MdmExternalAttribute, Contact, ContactPurpose, PhoneNumber, EmailAddress, PostalAddress, TrackedStatusType, StatusApplication, Currency, PricingPlan, ProductType, ProductFeature, OrderLineItem, OrderTxn, TrackedEntity, Project, Task, TaskType, ResourceAssignment, TimeEntry, Timesheet, ProjectPartyRole, TaskPartyRole, KanbanBoard, LlmConversationType, LlmConversationEntity, LlmConversation, LlmMessage, LlmFile, LlmDirectory, LlmConversationMember, LlmPrompt, LlmAgent, LlmModel, AgentSession, User, Configuration, ConfigurationType, OrchestrationTemplate, OrchestrationTemplateStage, OrchestrationTemplateTransition, OrchestrationExecution, OrchestrationStageExecution, OrchestrationArtifact, LlmAguiEvent, LlmAgentRun, AgentQueuedRequest, PlatformError, LlmAgentScorecard, LlmAgentTurnReview

FILTERS: Use model_schema_tool first to discover available filters for each model.
Pass filters via the filters parameter: {filters: {filter_name: value}}

SEARCH_QUERY: For complex queries with joins, operators, aggregates.
- where: {"field": "value"} or {"field": {"gt": 5}}
- joins: ["association"] or ["association.nested"]
- outputs: {"aggregate": "count"} or {"group_by": [...]}
Operators: eq, gt, gte, lt, lte, not, in, not_in, like, between, null

EXAMPLES:
List: {model_name: "Individual", action: "list", filters: {role_type_id: "customer"}}
Details: {model_name: "Individual", action: "details", id: 123}
Create: {model_name: "Individual", action: "create", attributes: {first_name: "Jane"}}
Search: {model_name: "Party", action: "list", search_query: {"where": {"custom_fields.dept": "eng"}}}
Link: {model_name: "ProductType", relationship_action: "link", id: 1, related_model_name: "PricingPlan", related_id: 2}

LINKS: Tasks, Projects, Files and Conversations come back with `app_link` — the page
a person opens. Link people with it, e.g. [Task #12](/app/task/12). Never hand a
person an /api/ URL; that is raw JSON, not a page.

PAGINATION: limit (default 10, -1 for all), offset
SORTING: sort: {column: "created_at", direction: "desc"}

CROSS-TENANT SHARED ACCESS: conversations, files, projects, and other shareable
records shared with you from other tenants are reachable. DETAILS falls back to
your shared access automatically when the id is not in your tenant; for LIST,
pass include_shared: true.

CUSTOM_FIELDS ON UPDATE: merged (deep) into the record's existing custom_fields —
send only the keys you are changing; omitted keys survive and an explicit null
deletes a key. Pass custom_fields_replace: true to replace the whole hash instead
(platform keys _field_metadata / orchestration_execution_id are still preserved
unless your hash explicitly includes them).

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `model_name` | string | yes | Name of the model to operate on. |
| `action` | string | yes | Action to perform (create, update, list, details, destroy) |
| `attributes` | object | no | Attributes for create/update actions. |
| `id` | integer | no | Record ID for update/details/destroy actions. |
| `limit` | integer | no | Maximum number of records to return (default: 10, -1 for all) |
| `offset` | integer | no | Number of records to skip. |
| `sort` | object | no | Enhanced sorting: {column: "column_name", direction: "asc"\|"desc"} or string "column:direction". Validates column exists. |
| `sort.column` | string | no | Column name to sort by (must exist in model) |
| `sort.direction` | string | no | Sort direction: "asc" (ascending) or "desc" (descending) One of: `asc`, `desc`. |
| `search_term` | string | no | Model-specific fuzzy search string, matched as a case-insensitive substring against the model's searchable columns (e.g. name, description) — NOT a SQL where clause. For exact-value lookups use filters or search_query instead. |
| `search_query` | object | no | Advanced search query with nested joins, JSON queries, and complex logic. Use dmapi_assistant_tool for documentation and examples. |
| `relationship_action` | string | no | Action for managing relationships (link, unlink, list_linked) |
| `related_model_name` | string | no | Name of the related model for relationship actions. |
| `related_id` | integer | no | ID of the related record for link/unlink actions. |
| `filters` | object | no | Model-specific filtering parameters for list action (see FILTERING SUPPORT in description) |
| `custom_fields_replace` | boolean | no | UPDATE only: custom_fields updates MERGE into the existing hash by default (send only the keys you are changing; an explicit null value deletes that key). Pass true to REPLACE the entire custom_fields hash instead — platform keys (_field_metadata, orchestration_execution_id) are still preserved unless your hash explicitly includes them. Default: false (merge). |
| `include_shared` | boolean | no | For LIST, UPDATE and DESTROY actions on shareable models (Project, Task, KanbanBoard, LlmConversation, LlmFile, LlmDirectory, etc.): include entities shared with the current user from other tenants — list adds shared records to the results; update/destroy let the caller act on a shared record by id (share permissions still apply). Default: false (tenant-only). DETAILS lookups fall back to cross-tenant shared access automatically when the id is not found in your tenant — no parameter needed. Only works when authenticated as a User (not APIKey). |

## Example

Discover the filters first, then list:

```json
{"name": "model_schema_tool", "arguments": {"model_name": "Task"}}
```

```json
{"name": "general_crud_tool", "arguments": {"model_name": "Task", "action": "list", "filters": {"project_id": 21}, "sort": {"column": "updated_at", "direction": "desc"}, "limit": 25}}
```

Returns a one-line summary followed by the matching records as JSON. `details` returns
one record; `create` and `update` return the saved record.

```json
{"name": "general_crud_tool", "arguments": {"model_name": "Task", "action": "update", "id": 3717, "attributes": {"description": "Updated write-up", "custom_fields": {"lane": "bne"}}}}
```

## Gotchas

- **Status is not an attribute.** "Mark done", "set to in progress", "close it" all go
  through [`apply_status_tool`](apply_status_tool.md). Passing `current_status` here is rejected.
- **`limit` defaults to 10.** Pass `limit: -1` for every row, or page with `offset`.
- **Messages are a JSON object.** An `LlmMessage` row's body is `message: {"role": "user", "content": "..."}`
  (not a top-level `content`). To post into a conversation prefer
  [`conversation_chat_tool`](conversation_chat_tool.md), which handles membership, fan-out and
  the optional model reply for you.
- **Files have their own tools.** Read, create, update and list `LlmFile` through the file tools
  (`read_llm_file_tool`, `create_llm_file_tool`, …) — they extract text, handle images and attach
  to conversations; raw CRUD on `LlmFile` does none of that.
- **Cross-tenant records.** `details` falls back to records shared with you automatically. For
  `list`, `update` and `destroy` on shareable models pass `include_shared: true`.
- **`custom_fields` merges on update.** Send only the keys you change; an explicit `null` deletes
  a key; `custom_fields_replace: true` swaps the whole hash.
- **`search_term` is a substring match** over the model's name-like columns, not a query language.
  Use `filters` for exact values and `search_query` for operators, joins and aggregates.
